Messages.Author: guntherbl
Messages.Body:
If a vampire retrieves a weapon with Horrid reality, is he or she
commited to strike with that weapon or may he or she eventually choose
another strike?

Thank you.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
In article <8v3mv1$o3b$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

guntherbl <gunt...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> If a vampire retrieves a weapon with Horrid reality, is he or she
> commited to strike with that weapon or may he or she eventually choose
> another strike?

IANALSJ, but:

Card text only tells you to equip with the weapon. You
are free to strike with it, or not, as you desire.

Josh

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <8v3mv1$o3b$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,
guntherbl <gunt...@my-deja.com> wrote:

>If a vampire retrieves a weapon with Horrid reality, is he or she
>commited to strike with that weapon or may he or she eventually choose
>another strike?

Card text makes no such requirement, so only the normal restriction (must
use it for strike if he maneuvers with it) applies.

gomi
